When CI review is on, the CI reviewer's summary with `Automated review: CLEAR` for that same head SHA is the final review summary, as `## CI review` says, here and in every step below. It names no base, so the base it includes is the base SHA that is an ancestor of that head, and its numbered procedure is the pull request body's `## Human verification` section at that head.

Fetch the base and require its SHA to equal the base SHA in the final verdict; after the CI reviewer's CLEAR, require it to be an ancestor of the reviewed head. When the base moved at all after the review, stop with `Status: BLOCKED_FOR_SYNC`: even a clean merge would produce an integration nobody reviewed. Never re-sync, re-verify or re-review from this skill, even when the gap looks mechanical; `address-pr-review` brings the branch up to date, and a fresh review follows.
